column1: # Native gates (from Project Pyrrhus by undecuple, re/spu/native_gates.tsv at 218f660, MIT;
# see THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md): lifted SPU job functions that hand over to a native host implementation
# (src/spu_native/). Pyrrhus names its 1.29 images by EBOOT file offset; the same modules are in the 1.01 disc and
# are named here as this port's lift names them (jobmod_<sha1[:12]>): each Gfx.Post and Particles module by the
# FNV-1a hash of the constant pool its kernels were written for, Anim.EdgeAnim (no pool) by its decoder at 0x10D78
# calling 0x13100 and 0x12438 three times each. tools/spu_native_gates.py inserts each gate as the first statement
# of the function; cont (an LS address) makes a "continue at" gate.
